audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Deliverance song, cosmic theophany, warfare, kingship, enemies, and the 2 Samuel 22 parallel.

verses.restored: I will love you, O YHWH, my strength.

familiar.text: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

notes.title: Parallel song
notes.body: Psalm 18 has a close parallel in 2 Samuel 22. Differences between the two forms are textual evidence and should be preserved rather than harmonized.

verses.restored: The YHWH is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

familiar.text: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

verses.restored: I will call upon the YHWH, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

familiar.text: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

verses.restored: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of wicked men made me afraid.

familiar.text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

verses.restored: The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of death confronted me.

familiar.text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

verses.restored: In my distress I called upon the YHWH, and cried to my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

familiar.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

verses.restored: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

familiar.text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

verses.restored: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

familiar.text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

verses.restored: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

familiar.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

verses.restored: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

familiar.text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

verses.restored: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

familiar.text: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

verses.restored: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

familiar.text: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

verses.restored: The YHWH also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

familiar.text: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

verses.restored: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

familiar.text: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

verses.restored: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at your rebuke, O YHWH, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

familiar.text: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

verses.restored: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

familiar.text: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

verses.restored: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

familiar.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.restored: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the YHWH was my stay.

familiar.text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

verses.restored: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

familiar.text: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.restored: The YHWH rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.

familiar.text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

verses.restored: For I have kept the ways of the YHWH, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

familiar.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.restored: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

familiar.text: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

verses.restored: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

familiar.text: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

verses.restored: Therefore has the YHWH recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

familiar.text: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

verses.restored: With the merciful you will show thyself merciful; with an upright man you will show thyself upright;

familiar.text: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

verses.restored: With the pure you will show thyself pure; and with the froward you will show thyself froward.

familiar.text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

verses.restored: For you will save the afflicted people; but will bring down high looks.

familiar.text: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

verses.restored: For you will light my candle: the YHWH my God will enlighten my darkness.

familiar.text: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

verses.restored: For by you I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

familiar.text: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

verses.restored: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the YHWH is tried: he is a shield to all those that trust in him.

familiar.text: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

verses.restored: For who is God save the YHWH? or who is a rock save our God?

familiar.text: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?

verses.restored: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and makes my way perfect.

familiar.text: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

verses.restored: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer and sets me securely on my heights.

familiar.text: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

verses.restored: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

familiar.text: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

verses.restored: You have also given me the shield of your salvation: and your right hand has holden me up, and your gentleness has made me great.

familiar.text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

verses.restored: You have enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

familiar.text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

verses.restored: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

familiar.text: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

verses.restored: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

familiar.text: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

verses.restored: For you have girded me with strength to the battle: you have subdued under me those that rose up against me.

familiar.text: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

verses.restored: You have also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

familiar.text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

verses.restored: They cried, but there was none to save them: even to the YHWH, but he answered them not.

familiar.text: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

verses.restored: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

familiar.text: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

verses.restored: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people; and you have made me the head of the nations: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

familiar.text: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

verses.restored: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves to me.

familiar.text: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

verses.restored: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

familiar.text: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

verses.restored: The YHWH liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

familiar.text: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

verses.restored: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

familiar.text: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

verses.restored: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, you liftest me up above those that rise up against me: you have delivered me from the violent man.

familiar.text: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

verses.restored: Therefore will I give thanks to you, O YHWH, among the nations, and sing praises to your name.

familiar.text: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

verses.restored: Great deliverance gives he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

familiar.text: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer. Curated overrides preserve major lexical or textual issues where identified.
safety_note: This royal war song cannot authorize holy war, nationalism, torture, domination, or modern enemy-mapping. Preserve its violence without endorsing it.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare every verse with 2 Samuel 22 and preserve differences between the parallel forms.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
